title: Digital Arrest Scam Call
goal: Isolate the senior and demand extortion money under fake warrants
red_flags: Threat of immediate arrest over a video call
Demanding money to clear legal charges
debrief_success: Excellent! Real police officers never conduct arrests or demand money over video calls.
debrief_failure: This is a dangerous 'Digital Arrest' scam. Law enforcement never asks for online transfers to drop charges.
